rows.definition: A NativeScheduler predicate reporting whether a schedLane's packed prefill candidate is locked, reserving that candidate against concurrent lane scheduling.
rows.distinction: It is a per-lane admission lock state inside the native scheduler, not the ctxplanner Candidate record scored for prefix reuse, nor a serve-time memory plan.

rows.definition: The OperationalCategory value 'plan_and_decompose' classifying initial prompts, high-level queries, and replan instructions as effort-high turns in the intra-model router.
rows.distinction: It is a turn-classification label that routes effort, not an execution Plan data type produced by a planner.

rows.definition: A buildwitness constructor producing the MatrixCompilePlan describing how one package variant compiles for one release target and output path.
rows.distinction: It plans build-matrix compilation steps for witness collection; it does not plan agent actions, dispatch waves, or serve memory.

rows.definition: A model package planner assigning one contiguous weight band to each device in order, minimizing cross-band traffic under per-device byte budgets.
rows.distinction: It partitions weights across several devices into bands; it is not the engine's single-device placement plan that maps whole tensors onto one device.

rows.definition: The gateway ModelLoadProfile field carrying the post-load diff between the fit planner's predicted memory and the allocation ledger's live numbers.
rows.distinction: It is the wire/debug projection of a finished load diff on the gateway profile; the agent-side once-per-serve state object holding the same diff is planLedgerDiffState.

rows.definition: An unexported agent package state holding the once-per-serve first-prefill diff between the in-kernel planner's prediction and the allocation ledger.
rows.distinction: It is the process-local holder inside the agent in-kernel planner; the gateway's exported wire copy of the same diff is PlanLedgerDiff on ModelLoadProfile.

rows.definition: The debtlane WavePlan field counting how many lanes the debt wave plan scheduled across its total waves.
rows.distinction: It counts lanes inside a debt-orchestrator wave plan; it is not the issue orchestrator's PlannedIssues count, which counts issues rather than lanes.

rows.definition: An agent package helper returning the error for requesting a given KV precision on a model/backend combination during in-kernel planner configuration.
rows.distinction: It validates one knob of InKernelPlannerConfig; it is not the planner itself, nor a serve-time memory plan.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak helper computing the serveGoMemoryLimitPlan that decides what Go runtime memory limit to set for a serve process given host load peak and total host memory.
rows.distinction: It sizes the Go runtime ceiling of the serve process; it does not size model weights or KV, which belong to the compute.MemoryPlan family.

rows.definition: A radixkv struct describing one contiguous segment of tokens in the executed prompt, recorded as part of a ReusePlan's span list.
rows.distinction: It is one segment row inside a radix-KV reuse plan; it is not the memq explain-plan PlanStep, which is a stage of a documented explain output.

rows.definition: The StrixComparatorPlanValidation field meaning the strix comparator manifest is internally complete enough to take to a real device.
rows.distinction: It is the verdict field of a fail-closed device-free validation result; the function producing that result is ValidateStrixComparatorPlan.

rows.definition: The macbench prefill-witness arm name 'candidate' identifying the candidate implementation side of a baseline-versus-candidate prefill benchmark.
rows.distinction: It names a benchmark arm in the macbench prefill witness; it is not the ctxplanner Candidate record scored for prefix reuse.

rows.canonical: PublishCandidates (V41 attention state candidate mask publish)
rows.definition: A V41AttentionState method recording the latest source-published V4.1 candidate mask and ratio for incremental attention.
rows.distinction: It publishes a ready candidate mask into attention state; it does not select candidate blocks from logits, which is V41SelectCandidateBlocks.

rows.definition: A compute package interface for a prepared device-resident Qwen4-expert PLE hash operation that is dispatched after preparation.
rows.distinction: It is a prepared CUDA kernel-operation handle; it is not a byte-budget MemoryPlan over model weights and KV.

rows.definition: The compiled regular expression matching the '<!-- fak:ctxplan' HTML-comment marker that declares a ctxplan skill block in markdown.
rows.distinction: It detects the markdown skill declaration; the companion reCtxplanVerb detects the '//fak:ctxplan' Go comment verb.

rows.definition: The compiled regular expression matching the '//fak:ctxplan' comment verb that marks Go source as ctxplan-managed.
rows.distinction: It detects the Go comment verb; the markdown skill declaration is matched by the separate reCtxplanSkill regex.

rows.definition: A devcmd helper resolving a strix candidate directory plus optional explicit tip and mine paths into a concrete resolvedStrixCandidate commit.
rows.distinction: It resolves which commit a strix candidate directory points at; it neither archives candidates (StrixCandidateArchive) nor builds the archive.

rows.definition: A radixkv struct representing the compiled execution and reuse layout for a prompt, composed from non-overlapping token spans covering the prompt range.
rows.distinction: It is the whole compiled radix-KV reuse layout; a single contiguous token segment inside it is a PlanSpan.

rows.definition: A goalrunner function running the contracts in a FleetPlan serially and recording witness evidence for each contract.
rows.distinction: It executes a fleet plan; the FleetPlan type it consumes is the data structure, and this is not a dispatch-wave execution plan.

rows.definition: The issue orchestrator wave-result field counting how many candidate issues the discovery scan examined before dispatchability filtering.
rows.distinction: It counts scanned issues in one discovery window; it is not the ratio of non-dispatchable ones (UnplannableRatio) nor the repair loop's CandidatesExamined counter.

rows.definition: The readmenext constant 'fak-readme-candidate/1' identifying the canonical schema of README candidate fragments.
rows.distinction: It is a schema identifier constant for candidate fragments; the fragment payload itself is the CandidateFragment type.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak struct echoing what the serve sizing artifact already sized so the fit plan re-reads no pool budget.
rows.distinction: It carries already-sized inputs into the fit plan; it is not the arch or hardware facts the fit plan also consumes.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak function computing the compute.MemoryPlan for one serve load arm's GGUF weight bytes under Q4K load options.
rows.distinction: It plans weight bytes for one specific load arm; the arm-neutral serveGGUFMemoryPlan covers the whole model, and the positioned serveGGUFMemoryPlanForArm ring plan is a separate concept.

rows.canonical: serveStreamedCPUOffloadCorePlan (streamed offload fold without context rows)
rows.definition: A cmd/fak function returning the streamed CPU-offload memory fold WITHOUT the context-sized rows, shared by the fit and load arms.
rows.distinction: It is the core fold without context-sized rows; the pool-topology and split-aperture variants add topology decisions around it.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak function that is serveStreamedCPUOffloadPlanForPool with the device split-aperture made backend-aware.
rows.distinction: It adds the split-aperture dimension on top of the pool variant; the core plan is the fold without context-sized rows.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak function that is serveStreamedCPUOffloadPlan with the shared host/device pool topology made explicit.
rows.distinction: It makes the pool topology explicit; the aperture variant further splits the device aperture, and the core plan omits context-sized rows.

rows.definition: A selfupdate Builder method recording whether candidate compilation reused shared warm worktree objects or populated cold entries, stamped on the update receipt.
rows.distinction: It stamps candidate-cache disposition onto a selfupdate receipt; it is not the clonescan token-window candidate cache nor a ctxplanner Candidate.

rows.definition: A gateway Server method installing the active agent.Planner used for chat turns on that server.
rows.distinction: It swaps the server's active planner instance; it is not the chatPlanner selection heuristic, nor the Plan data type a planner produces.

rows.definition: A model package side-effect-free decision for one stochastic speculative-decoding round, built from immutable evidence and optionally committed by the caller.
rows.distinction: It is the decision value; the immutable evidence it is built from is SpecRejectionPlanInput.

rows.definition: A model package struct carrying the immutable evidence for one stochastic speculative-decoding round fed to BuildSpecRejectionPlan.
rows.distinction: It is the input evidence; the resulting side-effect-free decision is SpecRejectionPlan.

rows.definition: A compute package planner managing speculative-decode CUDA graph capture dimensions and producing stable capture keys.
rows.distinction: It plans CUDA graph capture geometry for speculative decoding; it is not a chat-turn planner such as the gateway StreamingPlanner.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak helper extracting the context-window token count from a turnkey agent.Planner so 'fak up' can report it.
rows.distinction: It reads a property off an existing planner for the turnkey launch flow; it does not construct or configure planners.

rows.definition: A ggufload WeightSource method sizing the plan whose total simultaneous physical footprint bounds host-resident weight residency.
rows.distinction: It sizes unified host residency for weight loading; the session-scoped SessionResidencyPlan is a different residency concept, and MoE checkpoints are refused by name here.

rows.definition: The issue orchestrator's term for issues that cannot be turned into a dispatchable plan leaf, used in the --auto-expand flag help and the high-ratio advisory warning.
rows.distinction: It is the qualitative class name; the measured share of such issues is UnplannableRatio, and the threshold that triggers the advisory is UnplannableWarnRatio.

rows.definition: The issue orchestrator wave-result ratio of non-dispatchable (unplannable) issues to all scanned issues in one discovery window.
rows.distinction: It is the measured ratio; the warn threshold compared against it is UnplannableWarnRatio, and the raw scanned denominator is ScannedCandidates.

rows.definition: The issue orchestrator option and --unplannable-warn-ratio flag (default 0.65) setting the unplannable-ratio threshold that triggers the advisory warning and dynamic horizon expansion.
rows.distinction: It is the configured threshold; the measured value it guards is UnplannableRatio.

rows.definition: A process-wide C++ predicate in cuda_kernels.cu returning true when any V4.1 CUDA peer (checked stream, router, mmid, swiglu, engram, compressor pool, MHC, bf16 publish) has latched an uncertain state, refusing further shared-stream operations.
rows.distinction: It is the shared guard predicate consulted by every V4.1 CUDA entry point; it does not select candidate blocks, which is V41SelectCandidateBlocks.

rows.definition: A model package function implementing the first level of the V4.1 indexer, selecting top-K compressed blocks from logits into a candidate mask.
rows.distinction: It selects candidate blocks from logits; publishing a ready mask into attention state is PublishCandidates, and the stream guard they all consult is v41_candidates_stream_uncertain.

rows.definition: A validate package function checking that test events' candidate scopes stay inside the validated root before acceptance.
rows.distinction: It checks event-candidate scope in the validate harness; it is not the placement-tax validateCandidate feasibility validator.

rows.definition: A llamacppinterop function performing fail-closed device-free validation of a proposed StrixComparatorManifest's immutable identity, returning a StrixComparatorPlanValidation.
rows.distinction: It is the validating function; its PlanValid verdict field reports whether the manifest is complete enough for a real device.

rows.definition: A compute package deterministic lowering result for one Vulkan batch window, capturing barrier floors and hazard statistics.
rows.distinction: It is the lowered hazard result for one batch window; vulkan_plan is the broader command-buffer compute plan it feeds.
